name: Transit Zones
description:
This dataset defines transit zones used in New York City zoning and land-use rules, with each row representing one zone as a geographic area. The main field, transtzone, labels the zone type: Beyond the Greater Transit Zone, Outer Transit Zone, Inner Transit Zone, Manhattan Core and Long Island City Parking, and Special 25-241 Parking Provisions. Two numeric fields, shape_leng and shape_area, record the perimeter length and area of each zone's mapped boundary, indicating that the data is derived from geographic polygons. The sample shows five zones, one per category, with areas ranging from roughly 270 million to 3.9 billion square units and lengths from about 229,000 to 2.8 million units.

The dataset is useful for identifying which transit zone applies to a given location and for understanding the relative size and extent of each zone.
